rules.message: JsonNode/ObjectNode is an untyped payload (SC-TYPE). Define a record/DTO for the payload and map it at the boundary (ObjectMapper.treeToValue or readValue into the record). Waive only with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>` at the payload deserialization point.

Map<String, Object> is an untyped bag (SC-TYPE). Define a record/DTO with named fields, or Map<String, KnownType> when every value has one type. Waive only with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>` at the payload deserialization point.

Map<?, ?> hides both key and value types (SC-TYPE). Use Map<KnownKey, KnownValue>, or a record/DTO when the keys are fixed. Waive only with `stackcrew-allow: SC-TYPE <reason>` at the payload deserialization point.
Hardcoded URL (SC-CONST). Move it to a `static final` constant, or to @ConfigurationProperties / application.yml for per-environment endpoints. Waive only with `stackcrew-allow: SC-CONST <reason>`.
